articles.title_en: Cooperation, punishment, and group change in multilevel public goods experiments
articles.title_cn: 多层次公共品实验中的合作、惩罚与群体变更
articles.abstract_en: Peer punishment is regarded as an important element in sustaining human cooperation for public good provision. Many behavioral experiments have shown that public good provision is higher if cooperation norms can be enforced by peer punishment. These experiments predominantly focus on single-group public goods, in which people have to choose between their private interests and the interests of their group. However, many societal problems comprise multilevel public goods problems, where multiple local groups are nested within a larger global group. We study experimentally how punishment affects cooperation and norms in multilevel public goods games. In our lab experiment, two local groups are nested within a larger global group. Participants have to choose between not contributing, contributing locally, and contributing globally. Local contributions would lead to a fragmented outcome where two separate local public goods are provided, whereas global contributions would lead to a unified global good that benefits all. Moreover, we study whether cooperation and punishment patterns depend on the type of public good participants are initially exposed to: single-group or multilevel. Participants either begin in a single-group public goods game and then shift to a multilevel public goods game or vice versa. We find that punishment is less effective in multilevel public goods games than in single-group public goods games. Punishment only promotes cooperation in multilevel public goods games if people have prior experience with solving single-group public goods games. Our results refine the boundary conditions for the effectiveness of punishment and suggest that ‘starting small’ by first solving single-group public goods problems is helpful for successful multilevel public good provision.
articles.abstract_cn: 同伴惩罚被视为维持人类公共品供给合作的重要因素。许多行为实验表明，如果合作规范可以通过同伴惩罚来执行，公共品供给水平会更高。这些实验主要集中于单一群体公共品，在这种情境下，人们必须在个人利益与群体利益之间做出选择。然而，许多社会问题涉及多层次公共品问题，其中多个地方群体嵌套在一个更大的全球群体中。我们通过实验研究惩罚如何影响多层次公共品博弈中的合作与规范。在我们的实验室实验中，两个地方群体嵌套在一个更大的全球群体中。参与者必须在不出资、地方出资和全球出资之间做出选择。地方出资会导致碎片化的结果，即提供两个独立的地方公共品，而全球出资则会形成一个惠及所有人的统一全球公共品。此外，我们研究合作与惩罚模式是否取决于参与者最初接触的公共品类型：单一群体还是多层次。参与者要么从单一群体公共品博弈开始，然后转向多层次公共品博弈，要么反之。我们发现，在多层次公共品博弈中，惩罚的效果不如在单一群体公共品博弈中有效。只有当人们先前有解决单一群体公共品博弈的经验时，惩罚才能促进多层次公共品博弈中的合作。我们的结果细化了惩罚有效性的边界条件，并表明通过首先解决单一群体公共品问题来“从小处着手”有助于成功的多层次公共品供给。

articles.title_cn: 闲置流动性、央行数字货币与银行业
articles.abstract_en: We build models with an interest-bearing central bank digital currency (CBDC) to investigate whether the interest-bearing CBDC can lead to financial disintermediation. In the benchmark model with only CBDC, entrepreneurs can deposit their idle CBDC and banks can hold CBDC to satisfy the reserve requirement. CBDC and bank deposits become complements. A higher CBDC interest rate always promotes investment and may or may not reduce bank lending, because the higher return on CBDC encourages entrepreneurs to accumulate more CBDC and deposit more. More deposits could in turn lead to more bank lending. The interest rate on reserves and the reserve requirement ratio can be effective policy tools that affect bank lending and investment. We consider extensions where cash and interest-bearing CBDC can coexist. The coexistence may require the central bank to adjust the CBDC interest rate or the interest rate on reserves. Our results suggest that the relationship between CBDC and bank deposits are crucial for understanding the effects of CBDC on banking and the macroeconomy.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了含有计息央行数字货币（CBDC）的模型，以研究计息CBDC是否会导致金融脱媒。在仅含CBDC的基准模型中，企业家可以存入其闲置的CBDC，银行可以持有CBDC以满足准备金要求。CBDC与银行存款成为互补品。较高的CBDC利率总是促进投资，并可能减少或不减少银行贷款，因为较高的CBDC回报鼓励企业家积累更多CBDC并存入更多。更多的存款反过来可能导致更多的银行贷款。准备金利率和准备金率可以作为影响银行贷款和投资的有效政策工具。我们考虑了现金与计息CBDC共存的扩展情形。共存可能需要中央银行调整CBDC利率或准备金利率。我们的结果表明，CBDC与银行存款之间的关系对于理解CBDC对银行业和宏观经济的影响至关重要。

articles.title_cn: 公共支出乘数与非正规经济
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the role of informality in affecting the magnitude of the public expenditure multiplier in a panel of 142 countries, using the local projections method. We find a strong negative relationship between the degree of informality and the size of the multiplier. This result holds irrespective of the level of economic development and institutional quality and is robust to additional country characteristics such as trade and financial openness and exchange rate regime. In a two-sector New-Keynesian model, we rationalize this result by showing that fiscal shocks raise the relative price of official goods, thereby shifting demand towards the informal sector. This reallocation effect increases with the level of informality, because a larger informal sector is associated with a stronger appreciation of relative prices in response to fiscal shocks, and thus reduces the multiplier.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用局部投影方法，在包含142个国家的面板数据中研究了非正规经济对公共支出乘数规模的影响。我们发现非正规经济程度与乘数大小之间存在强烈的负相关关系。这一结果无论经济发展水平和制度质量如何均成立，并且对贸易开放度、金融开放度和汇率制度等其他国家特征具有稳健性。在一个两部门新凯恩斯模型中，我们通过证明财政冲击提高了官方商品的相对价格，从而将需求转向非正规部门，来解释这一结果。这种再配置效应随着非正规经济程度的提高而增强，因为更大的非正规部门与财政冲击下相对价格的更强烈升值相关，从而降低了乘数。

articles.title_en: Oligopoly banking, risky investment, and monetary policy
articles.title_cn: 寡头银行业、风险投资与货币政策
articles.abstract_en: Oligopolistic competition in the banking sector and risk in the real economy are important characteristics of many economies. We build a model of monetary policy transmission that incorporates these characteristics which allows us to analyze the long-run consequences of variations in the degree of banking competition. We show theoretically that various equilibrium cases can occur, and that the effect of monetary policy varies greatly across equilibrium cases. We calibrate the model to the U.S. economy in 2016-2019 and find that monetary policy pass-through is incomplete under imperfect competition. Further, we show that a decrease in the policy rate during the calibration period would have increased expected welfare, but also bank default probability.
articles.abstract_cn: 银行业部门的寡头竞争和实体经济中的风险是许多经济体的重要特征。我们构建了一个纳入这些特征的货币政策传导模型，使我们能够分析银行业竞争程度变化的长期后果。我们从理论上表明，可能出现各种均衡情形，且货币政策的效果在不同均衡情形下差异很大。我们将模型校准到2016-2019年的美国经济，发现在不完全竞争下货币政策传导是不完全的。此外，我们表明，在校准期间政策利率的下降本会增加预期福利，但也会增加银行违约概率。

articles.title_en: Pro-sociality of local democratic leaders: The impact and dynamics of being elected
articles.title_cn: 地方民主领导人的亲社会性：当选的影响与动态
articles.abstract_en: Democratic regimes need leaders with high intrinsic motivation to serve their constituents. In this paper, we investigate the levels of leaders’ pro-social motivation, how such levels differ from those of villagers, whether they are affected when the leaders are elected, and the persistence over several years. A regression discontinuity design based on close elections combined with a panel of incentivized lab-in-the-field measures of solidarity reveals that being elected and holding office as a local leader results in making more pro-social choices two and six years after the election. An additional experiment measuring normative expectations towards leaders suggests that leaders' higher pro-sociality may come from internalizing these expectations. We also discuss the role of income, collective action and network ties and how the increase in pro-sociality relates to local level corruption.
articles.abstract_cn: 民主制度需要具有高度内在动机为选民服务的领导人。在本文中，我们考察了领导人的亲社会动机水平、这些水平与村民的差异、当选是否影响这些水平，以及多年间的持续性。基于接近选举的断点回归设计，结合一组激励性的实地实验室团结度量面板数据，我们发现，当选并担任地方领导人会在选举后两年和六年做出更多亲社会选择。一项额外实验测量了对领导人的规范性期望，结果表明领导人的更高亲社会性可能源于内化这些期望。我们还讨论了收入、集体行动和网络联系的作用，以及亲社会性的增加与地方层面腐败的关系。

articles.title_en: Decomposing China’s bilateral export growth: A firm-regional-transactions structural gravity approach
articles.title_cn: 分解中国双边出口增长：一种企业-区域-交易结构引力方法
articles.abstract_en: This paper undertakes a decomposition of China’s firm-transaction-level exports with an emphasis on aggregates thereof at the prefectural level. Chinese prefectures are large and, relative to some smaller countries, the larger ones are visible players in the world market. We decompose China’s prefecture-product-level bilateral exports to foreign countries into their main components. These are factor costs, market potential (including trade frictions and foreign expenditure) as well as quality and productivity. We consider the latter two as to be drawn from a bivariate Pareto distribution that is specific to prefectures, products, and countries. This strategy enables retrieving fixed market access costs and permits conducting counterfactual experiments with a focus on the distribution across Chinese prefectures.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文对中国企业-交易层面的出口进行分解，重点在于地级市层面的总量。中国的地级市规模较大，相对于一些较小的国家，较大的地级市是世界市场上可见的参与者。我们将中国地级市-产品层面的对国外双边出口分解为其主要组成部分。这些包括要素成本、市场潜力（包括贸易摩擦和外国支出）以及质量和生产率。我们将后两者视为从特定于地级市、产品和国家的二元帕累托分布中抽取。这一策略使得能够获取固定市场进入成本，并允许进行以中国地级市分布为重点的反事实实验。

articles.title_en: Competition, equity and quality in public services
articles.title_cn: 公共服务中的竞争、公平与质量
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the implications of consumer heterogeneity for the choice of competition and monopoly in public services delivery. In a setting with motivated providers who favour one type of service user over another, we show that competition can raise average quality. However, this may be at the expense of the minority type of user if the providers favour the majority type. Then an inequity averse regulator may protect the minority by not introducing competition. Alternatively, if the providers favour the minority type, the regulator may introduce competition to incentivize the providers to pay attention to the less rewarding majority type.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了消费者异质性对公共服务提供中竞争与垄断选择的影响。在存在有动机的提供者偏好某一类服务用户而非另一类的环境中，我们表明竞争可以提高平均质量。然而，如果提供者偏好多数类型用户，这可能以牺牲少数类型用户为代价。那么，一个厌恶不公平的监管者可能通过不引入竞争来保护少数群体。或者，如果提供者偏好少数类型，监管者可能引入竞争以激励提供者关注回报较少的多数类型。

articles.title_cn: 贸易政策不确定性与资源错配
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the role of trade policy uncertainty (TPU) on resource allocation across heterogeneous Chinese producers and aggregate productivity in the Chinese manufacturing sector. Using detailed Chinese data and common cost minimization conditions we measure the difference between optimal capital and labor holdings for each firm, or the efficiency gap. We document that (i) efficiency gaps decline sharply with China’s accession to the WTO and the declines are disproportionately pronounced among industries most exposed to TPU; (ii) efficiency gap declines were larger among Chinese exporters; (iii) efficiency gap declines occur simultaneously with a rise in the variance of firm-level employment and investment in new capital. Using China’s accession to the WTO as an exogenous change in the degree of uncertainty faced by Chinese producers, we quantify the implied change in productivity due to the reduction in TPU. Our estimates imply that the reduction in TPU induced by WTO accession accounted for a 17% increase in aggregate productivity through reduced resource misallocation.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了贸易政策不确定性（TPU）对中国异质性生产者之间的资源配置以及中国制造业部门总体生产率的作用。利用详细的中国数据和常见的成本最小化条件，我们衡量了每个企业最优资本和劳动持有量之间的差异，即效率缺口。我们记录了以下事实：（i）随着中国加入WTO，效率缺口急剧下降，且这种下降在受TPU影响最大的行业中尤为显著；（ii）效率缺口的下降在中国出口企业中更为明显；（iii）效率缺口的下降与企业层面就业和新资本投资方差的上升同时发生。利用中国加入WTO作为中国生产者面临不确定性程度的外生变化，我们量化了由于TPU减少所隐含的生产率变化。我们的估计表明，加入WTO所引发的TPU减少，通过减少资源错配，使总体生产率提高了17%。

articles.title_en: Intergenerational assimilation of minorities: The role of the majority group
articles.title_cn: 少数族群的代际同化：多数群体的作用
articles.abstract_en: We develop a dynamic model of assimilation of ethnic minorities that posits a trade-off between higher productivity and wages and greater social distance from the culture of origin. We primarily highlight the importance of the intergenerational linkage of assimilation and also incorporate the role of the majority group in the assimilation of ethnic minorities. We first show how the assimilation of the past generation is transmitted to the subsequent generation, and then characterize the intragenerational and intergenerational externalities. Moreover, we explore the interaction of the minority and majority decisions, which accompanies a hump-shaped relationship between the act to tolerate of the majority individuals and the level of assimilation in the society. Such a relationship is also transmitted via intergenerational linkage and causes additional externalities. In fact, more tolerance from the majority group generates positive externalities for the minority group, while each minority group’s assimilation effort affects the welfare of the majority individuals differently depending on the initial minority assimilation level.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个关于少数族群同化的动态模型，该模型假设在更高生产率和工资与更大文化起源社会距离之间存在权衡。我们主要强调同化的代际联系的重要性，并纳入多数群体在少数族群同化中的作用。我们首先展示过去一代的同化如何传递给下一代，然后刻画代内和代际外部性。此外，我们探讨少数群体与多数群体决策的相互作用，这伴随着多数个体容忍行为与社会同化水平之间的驼峰形关系。这种关系也通过代际联系传递，并导致额外外部性。事实上，多数群体更多的容忍对少数群体产生正外部性，而每个少数群体的同化努力对多数个体福利的影响取决于初始少数群体同化水平的不同而不同。

articles.title_en: Global corporate income tax competition, knowledge spillover, and growth
articles.title_cn: 全球企业所得税竞争、知识溢出与增长
articles.abstract_en: Using a two-country model of endogenous growth with international knowledge spillovers, this study analyzes the welfare consequences of global corporate income tax competition. Although the Nash equilibrium tax rate can be excessively high or low according to the degree of spillover, this does not lead to significant welfare losses. The key to this outcome is that corporate income tax competition for growth maximization, which we consider hypothetically, attains the maximum growth rate despite complex externalities and strategic interactions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究利用一个具有国际知识溢出的两国内生增长模型，分析了全球企业所得税竞争的福利后果。尽管根据溢出程度，纳什均衡税率可能过高或过低，但这并不会导致显著的福利损失。这一结果的关键在于，我们假设性地考虑的以增长最大化为目标的企业所得税竞争，尽管存在复杂的外部性和战略互动，仍能达到最大增长率。

articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a new theory for why income inequality can be conducive to early industrial development. Technological advances in agriculture and population growth increase land rents relative to wages and as the landed elites become richer, demand for manufactured goods increases, which in turn facilitates industrialization. Using data for Britain over the period 1270–1940, we show that increasing inequality was a major contributor to the expansion of the manufacturing sector. Taking into account the more well-known drivers of modern growth, we find that inequality is a major contributor to the British Industrial Revolution, alongside foreign trade, education, technological knowledge and, to some extent, institutions.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们提出了一个新的理论，解释为什么收入不平等可能有利于早期工业发展。农业技术进步和人口增长提高了相对于工资的地租，随着土地精英变得更加富有，对制成品的需求增加，这反过来促进了工业化。利用英国1270-1940年间的数据，我们表明不平等程度的加剧是制造业扩张的主要贡献因素。考虑到现代增长更为知名的驱动因素，我们发现不平等是英国工业革命的主要贡献者，与对外贸易、教育、技术知识以及在某种程度上制度因素并列。

articles.title_en: How far from full employment? The European unemployment problem revisited
articles.title_cn: 距离充分就业还有多远？欧洲失业问题再探讨
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyses deviations from full employment in EU countries, compared with the US and the UK. We apply the Beveridge (full-employment-consistent) rate of unemployment (BECRU), derived from the unemployment-vacancies relationship. The BECRU is the unemployment rate that minimises the non-productive use of labour. Based on a novel dataset over 1970–2022, we find full employment episodes in selected EU countries (Germany, Sweden, Austria, Finland) during the 1970s. The European unemployment problem emerged in the 1980s and 1990s, as Beveridgean full employment gaps increased. In the run-up to the global financial crisis, full employment gaps declined, then increased during the Great Recession. Slack in labour markets initially increased during the pandemic. Labour markets became tighter when recovering from the COVID-19 crisis, but few countries hit full employment. We show that Beveridgean full employment gaps are informative in predicting the share of young people who are unemployed and not receiving education or vocational training.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了欧盟国家与美国和英国相比偏离充分就业的情况。我们应用了从失业-职位空缺关系中推导出的贝弗里奇（充分就业一致）失业率（BECRU）。BECRU是使劳动的非生产性使用最小化的失业率。基于1970-2022年的新数据集，我们发现选定的欧盟国家（德国、瑞典、奥地利、芬兰）在1970年代存在充分就业时期。欧洲失业问题出现在1980年代和1990年代，当时贝弗里奇充分就业缺口扩大。在全球金融危机前夕，充分就业缺口缩小，随后在大衰退期间扩大。疫情期间劳动力市场闲置最初增加。从COVID-19危机中复苏时，劳动力市场趋紧，但很少有国家达到充分就业。我们表明，贝弗里奇充分就业缺口在预测未就业且未接受教育或职业培训的年轻人比例方面具有信息价值。

articles.title_en: The economic impact of yield curve compression: Evidence from euro area forward guidance and unconventional monetary policy
articles.title_cn: 收益率曲线压缩的经济影响：来自欧元区前瞻性指引和非常规货币政策的证据
articles.abstract_en: Unconventional monetary policies have now been part of the toolkit of developed economy central banks for well over a decade. The question of how their effects have changed over time is therefore an important one. This paper studies the impact of multiple forms of monetary policy surprise for the case of the ECB. I employ a semi-parametric time-varying VAR-X framework, which allows one to chart the changing responses of a broad range of financial and macroeconomic variables simultaneously. I develop high-frequency series that separate forward guidance from yield curve compression surprises — the use of the latter allows one to learn about the effects of flattening yield curves through the history of the ECB, including those induced by its Expanded Asset Purchase Programme (APP). Forward guidance surprises are found to have their maximum impact on inflation when these policies were linked to the duration of the APP. Yield curve compression surprises are shown to transition from largely financial effects on equity markets and risk, to having a greater effect on prices at the time of the APP. However, the maximal effect of the APP on prices is found to occur after its maximal effect at flattening the yield curve, indicating delayed transmission.
articles.abstract_cn: 非常规货币政策已成为发达经济体中央银行政策工具的一部分已超过十年。因此，其效果如何随时间变化是一个重要问题。本文以欧洲央行为例，研究了多种形式的货币政策冲击的影响。我采用半参数时变VAR-X框架，该框架能够同时描绘广泛的金融和宏观经济变量的变化响应。我开发了高频序列，将前瞻性指引与收益率曲线压缩冲击区分开来——后者可用于通过欧洲央行的历史（包括其扩大资产购买计划（APP）所引发的冲击）来了解收益率曲线平坦化的影响。研究发现，当前瞻性指引政策与APP的持续时间相关联时，其对通胀的影响最大。收益率曲线压缩冲击被证明从主要对股票市场和风险产生金融影响，转变为在APP时期对价格产生更大影响。然而，APP对价格的最大影响发生在其对收益率曲线平坦化的最大影响之后，表明传导存在延迟。
